/bin/bash -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
import gzip,re
vcf='work/raw.vcf'
rows=[]
for line in open(vcf):
    if line.startswith('#'): continue
    f=line.rstrip('\\n').split('\\t')
    info=dict(x.split('=',1) for x in f[7].split(';') if '=' in x)
    fmt=f[8].split(':'); vals=f[9].split(':')
    d=dict(zip(fmt,vals))
    dp=int(info.get('DP',d.get('DP','0')))
    ad=d.get('AD','').split(',')
    try: alt=int(ad[1]) if len(ad)>1 else 0
    except: alt=0
    rows.append((dp,alt,int(d.get('DP',0)),f[1],f[3],f[4],float(f[5])))
print('n',len(rows))
import collections
print('max dp',sorted(rows,reverse=True)[:20])
print('dp hist',collections.Counter(r[0] for r in rows).most_common(30))
print('alt>=3',sum(1 for r in rows if r[1]>=3))
for r in sorted([r for r in rows if r[1]>=3], key=lambda x:-x[0])[:50]: print(r)
PY"
